releaseState: Local candidate qualified; footer composition and canonical internal-navigation repairs are not deployed by this audit.

contentPurpose.evidence: The first viewport explains the core distinction from one-off Lighthouse tests, realistic repeated presets, percentile distributions, local execution, and the absence of a remote account. The live controller then gives truthful v0.4.2 setup instructions.

designQuality.evidence: The restrained performance-lab visual system has strong hierarchy, an illustrative percentile chart, and a coherent setup surface. Exact 390 and 1440 pixel checks found zero horizontal overflow or console errors and both required fleet footer elements.

seo.evidence: All 14 critical homepage checks passed with valid canonical, social metadata, WebPage schema, hierarchy, and links. The local six-page graph has zero errors, redirects, or orphan candidates after replacing page-relative navigation; the only advisory is the app-like homepage's roughly 258 words.

geo.evidence: The production agent-index audit is S-tier 100 with llms.txt, agent API, homepage Markdown, robots permission, sitemap coverage, and JSON-LD.

performance.evidence: PSI Swarm completed 4/4 coverage profiles. Weighted LCP was 0.954 s, mobile-mid 0.848 s, mobile-fast 0.473 s, desktop 0.282 s, CLS 0.031, and TBT 0 ms. The harsh slow-3G profile reached 4.73 s and Lighthouse identified about 27 KiB of unused JavaScript, acceptable as a P4 advisory.
